issue: The SOS ride's own queue row was the least legible row on screen: the strip's `.sos` rule also matched `.r.sos`, so its address and age rendered in the strip's white (light) / near-black (dark) ink on a pale ground, inside a card-shaped box.
fix: Scoped the strip rule to `section.sos`; the row keeps its red spine, SOS tag and selection ring with normal ink.

issue: The driver's «Չեմ հասցնի» request, the only pre-order needing a human, sat fifth in the hour-ordered lane, under the fold at 1366×768.
fix: Rows that need a human now lead the Scheduled lane (as Problems leads the Now tab), the rest stay by promised hour; the lane head says so.

issue: With Զվարթնոց → Կենտրոն fixed at 5 000 ֏ for City/Comfort only, Business (4 100 ֏) and Vip (5 800 ֏) read cheaper than or barely above City, inverting the tier ladder the dispatcher quotes from.
fix: Business and Vip take the pair's per-tier fixed fares (7 000 / 8 500 ֏, matching zones?pair=1's per-tier list); only Van stays metered + 500 ֏.

issue: The company badge «Արարատ Սոֆթ · ընկերության հաշվին», the fact that decides who pays, ran out of the customer card and was cut at its edge.
fix: The card's title line wraps (badge under the name, inside the card); the form scrolls to its foot so no label straddles the action bar.

issue: Key 1 of the tier grid, «Մոտակա ազատը», was ellipsised in every intake state at both sizes, so the first of eight choices could not be read.
fix: The icon-only 'any' cell takes a 20px icon column instead of the car's 40px; the label fits at 1366.

issue: The low-rating reason repeated the threshold «(1–3 ★)» beside the row's own «★ 2» tag and lost the driver's name to the ellipsis.
fix: Dropped the redundant threshold; the reason reads «Ցածր գնահատական · «Կոպիտ էր» · Տիգրան Ա.» in full.

issue: The card option's fee claim «պահված քարտը · +2 % վճար» was cut to «+2 % վճ…», hiding the one thing that differs from cash.
fix: Shortened to «+2 % վճար»; «·· 3318» already says it is the saved card.

issue: Ledger titles «Միջնորդավճար · #R-20288» truncated to «#R-2…», so the ride number (the key an operator searches by) was lost in every fee row.
fix: Title is the kind («Միջնորդավճար»); the ride number or ride count leads the wrapping detail line.

issue: The red-outlined «Ուղևորը չեկավ» sat flush against the red-filled «Կիրառել», two adjacent dangerous targets of similar weight one mis-click apart.
fix: The two are pushed to opposite ends of the row (still one click deep, §9.4).

issue: The SOS strip's «ձայնը կրկնվում է» note at 12px with opacity .85 measured 6.73:1 in dark, under the console's 7:1 small-text floor; the map pin's pulse ring was counted as a clip.
fix: Note at full ink; the pulse ring drawn inside the pin's box.

issue: The payer block («Ընկերություն · Արարատ Սոֆթ») sits under the head while the fare it pays («Ընդամենը · Ընկերության հաշվին») is three sections down, below the map and driver, past the fold.
fix: Put Payer directly under the price breakdown (one money region) and move rating after it.
note: Payer row now sits in the price breakdown directly above the total; the old payer block became «Ընկերության ամիս» (month + rider).

issue: A ride whose ETAPI receipt failed three times reads «Ավարտված» in the list like every other finished ride; the failure is only visible after opening it.
fix: Add an amber receipt icon/tag in the price cell of rows with an unsent or failed fiscal receipt (the same item is in Requests → fiscal).
note: Ride 20409 shows a red «Կտրոն չկա» pill (circle-alert) in the fixed status column of the list; red because the ETAPI filing actually failed.

issue: Pending partner cars carry «Հաստատել» right in the list, a second approval path that skips Approvals' six-document check and class choice.
fix: Replace it with «Ստուգել →» linking to approvals.html for that car; keep Reject in place.
note: «Հաստատել» removed for pending partner cars; «Ստուգել →» links to approvals.html, «Մերժել» stays. Suspended-car «Հաստատել» (reinstate) left as is.

issue: The money section mixes the rider's side (fare, +2 % fee, method, ETAPI receipt) with the driver's payout (Idram to driver) under one «Վճարում» head.
fix: Split into «Ուղևորը» and «Վարորդին» sub-heads with the payout last.
note: Payment section split into «Ուղևորը» (method, ETAPI type, receipt) and «Վարորդին» (Idram payout) sub-heads, payout last.

issue: The tier label says «1–8» but no tile shows its digit, so a dispatcher counts positions to find Van's key.
fix: Show the key as a faint 11px mono digit in each tile's corner (the price column has the room).
note: Each tier tile (and the any/transfer tiles) shows its key as a faint 11px mono digit above the price.

issue: No state shows the phone field accepting +374 / 374 / 8-digit / spaced input and normalising it; only the refusal's single example format is drawn.
fix: Draw a pasted «+374 93 15 62 40» normalising to «093 15-62-40» in the read-back, and keep the refusal for genuinely short numbers.
note: New state ?intake=phone: pasted «+374 93 15 62 40» with a read-back «Ընդունվեց՝ 093 15-62-40»; the refusal stays for short numbers.

issue: With the payer chosen in «Վճարող», the Payment select below repeats «Ընկերություն» as a second control for the same decision.
fix: Collapse Payment into a read-only line when the payer is the company (one choice, one place).
note: With the company as payer, Payment is a read-only locked line (building icon + lock) instead of a second select.

issue: At 1366×768 the SOS ride's row (Active lane, last) is below the fold; the strip carries the calls, but «open the ride» needs a scroll.
fix: Make the strip's ride number a link that selects and scrolls to the row.
note: SOS strip ride number is a link that scrolls to and focuses the ride's row.

issue: The lost-claim state is drawn, but no state shows the instant own-claim feedback between pressing T and the server's answer.
fix: Draw the row with «Դուք» and a pending dot for the round-trip, replaced by «Իմը» on 200 or by the blue conflict line on 409.
note: New state ?state=claiming: row reads «Դուք» with a pending dot (aria-busy) until 200 or 409.

issue: In the selected deletion row the day «երեկ» is cut to «եր…» by the «Բաց հերթափոխ» tag.
fix: Give the time column a fixed min width like the other rows and let the tag sit after it.
note: Status column widened 112 to 132px so the day «երեկ» and the «Բաց հերթափոխ» tag both fit.

issue: The date column truncates «29 սեպ…», so the oldest match's date is the one row an operator cannot read.
fix: Widen the time column to fit «21:40 29 սեպտ.» or use the numeric «29.09».
note: Time column widened 132 to 160px; «29 սեպտ.» reads in full.

issue: The worked-example rail lists «Կլորացում 100 ֏ · 1 000 ֏», which reads as a 1 000 ֏ rounding charge rather than the rounded subtotal.
fix: Label the line «Կլորացված՝ 1 000 ֏» and show the rounding delta (e.g. «−13 ֏») separately, as the ride panel does.
note: Rail line now «կլորացված՝ ±N ֏» with the rounded subtotal as its value, delta shown in the label.

issue: The fare-explanation steps are numbered 1, 2, 2, 3, so two different rules share a step number.
fix: Number them 1–4 or mark the two zone lines as 2a/2b under one 'zone rules' step.

issue: The «Այսօր» column joins count and earnings as «9 · 14 820 ֏» with no unit on the count.
fix: Split into two right-aligned mono sub-columns (rides, ֏) or write «9 պ.».
note: «Այսօր» reads «9 պ. · 14 820 ֏»; column widened (168px, 160px at 1366) so the fare is not truncated.

issue: Problem-row actions (Assign, Send to search, Force state) are 24px-high buttons, the smallest targets on the screen for the rows that most need a click.
fix: Keep the keys (A) as the primary path; raise problem-row buttons to 28px (S), the row already has a third line for them.
note: Problem-row buttons are 28px high (icon 28x28) via .r.p .btn.xs; the row's acts line already was 28px.

issue: «Հաստատել՝ Eco Comfort» is fully armed while the checklist reads 5/6 with the right-side photo missing, so the button gives no sense of how close the car is to ready.
fix: Carry the count in the button («Հաստատել՝ Eco Comfort · 5/6») or arm it only when every required slot is ticked.
note: Button carries the count: «Հաստատել՝ Eco Comfort · 5/6». It stays armed (operator may approve with a missing slot).
